name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with Soviet-era engineering. He spent countless hours tinkering with engines and metalwork in his father's garage. After completing his technical education in Moscow, he initially worked in aerospace before transitioning to motorsport, drawn by the competitive spirit and rapid pace of innovation. He believes in meticulous preparation and a hands-on approach, always seeking practical solutions and robust designs.

His experience spans various racing disciplines, from rally to circuit racing, giving him a broad understanding of vehicle dynamics and stress points. Dimitri is known for his resourcefulness and ability to adapt to changing conditions, making him a valuable asset in any team. He joined Walkinshaw Andretti United hoping to contribute his expertise to a team with a rich history and ambitious goals, finding a real home there. 

Dimitri is calm under pressure, and known for his exacting standards, he's a perfectionist who always strives for optimal performance, even if it means working late into the night. He has a reputation for being able to fix anything with the right tools and a bit of ingenuity.

physical.description: Dimitri is a stocky man with a strong build and calloused hands that speak to years of working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils with a pocketknife, even if there's a sharpener nearby.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport patches on his workshop apron.
Humming old Soviet-era tunes while working on complex fabrication challenges.
